preconditions: The five named public repositories retain the IDs recorded in the preflight state.
Lab remains private and is not mutated.
All active repositories continue to report zero Actions workflows.
No repository rename, archive, branch, release, issue, or project mutation is included.
expected_postconditions: All six active repositories report private visibility.
Repository IDs, names, default branches, archival state, and Git remotes remain unchanged.
No active repository owns CI/CD or Actions workflows.
A completed state receipt records the exact post-operation metadata.
record.retry: Retry one idempotent visibility update only when the repository ID and current visibility still match the preflight record; otherwise stop.
stop_conditions: Any repository ID, name, default branch, or archival state differs from the preflight record.
A visibility update would require a repository rename, transfer, deletion, or release mutation.
Any active Actions workflow appears before mutation.
GitHub rejects private visibility for an exact repository and the remaining topology would become ambiguous.
record.reversibility: Repository visibility can be changed back through a separately authorized GitHub settings operation; Git history and repository IDs are unchanged.
irreversible_effects: Public discovery, stars, forks, and external links may be affected according to GitHub visibility-change behavior.
